product_one_liner.value: Ethos uses AI to match professionals with paid consulting, advisory, research, and other work opportunities, while helping companies find and engage the expertise they need.
product_one_liner.notes: The AskEthos homepage says companies seek people with users' backgrounds and offers paid consulting, advisory calls, and research; the company profile describes AI matching clients with experts. These support the sentence's product and audience.

pricing_page.notes: Ethos's Ethos Evals page has a public Pricing page with its per-task fee structure, and the company's LinkedIn post identifies the Eval platform as Ethos's own product. Therefore the company does have a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Ethos Recruiting's first-party homepage labels the section 'Companies hiring with Ethos' and names Elm Labs and Kendal.ai. | named_customers.0: Elm Labs is named in the 'Companies hiring with Ethos' section. | named_customers.1: Kendal.ai is named in the 'Companies hiring with Ethos' section.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Ethos's own role listing identifies its London HQ in Kings Cross, and its privacy policy gives the registered office in London. | hq_country: Ethos's own role listing calls its London location the London HQ, and its privacy policy places its registered office in London, United Kingdom; together these support the headquarters country.

founded_year.notes: Ethos's LinkedIn company profile identifies the company as founded in 2024.

eng_blog.notes: The complete Latest Updates index lists product announcements and feature updates, with its newest dated item July 1, 2025; it does not show a technical engineering blog with at least two build-focused posts.

public_docs.notes: The Ethos Evals documentation index lists only one MCP-server documentation article; the main Ethos site footer links to privacy, terms, and expert terms but no docs/help center. The observed materials do not meet the requirement for several public documentation articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The direct Ethos AI Engineer opportunity is marked closed. The live board entries shown are expert-call or expert-opportunity assignments for outside clients, not Ethos employee openings; no open in-house AI/ML posting is shown.

model_provider.value: Google (Gemini), Anthropic, Groq, OpenAI, and OpenRouter.
model_provider.notes: The public subprocessor list names Anthropic and identifies Google Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, and OpenRouter as AI/language, inference, or model-routing services engaged by Ethos.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Ethos's Data Processing Agreement says its processing is intended to ensure compliance with UK GDPR and, where applicable, EU GDPR; GDPR is the named item in the requested list. The source describes a regulation rather than a formal certification, so this is a cautious mapping to the schema's list. | compliance_certs.0: The DPA explicitly names UK GDPR and EU GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The most recent round is explicitly described as a Series A in May 2026, after the March 2025 seed round. | funding_date: The announced latest round is dated May 6, 2026, so its month-formatted date is 2026-05; Dealroom confirms it followed the March 2025 seed. | funding_amount_usd: TechCrunch reports Ethos's $22.75 million Series A on May 6, 2026; Dealroom's round history identifies it as the later round after the March 2025 seed. The amount converts to 22,750,000 USD.

raised_18mo.notes: Ethos announced the Series A on May 6, 2026, which falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The visible Account Executive opportunity is to train an outside AI lab's model, not an Ethos employee job; the current board entries are expert gigs and show no in-house SDR/BDR/AE vacancy.

launched_6mo.notes: Ethos's LinkedIn company page dates its announcement opening a private beta of its Eval platform to November 6, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Ethos's subprocessor list names Apollo and RevenueBase and describes both as B2B sales-intelligence and lead-generation providers, which are visible sales/marketing stack signals. | crm_stack_signal.0: The subprocessor list names Apollo and classifies it as B2B sales intelligence and lead generation. | crm_stack_signal.1: The subprocessor list names RevenueBase and classifies it as B2B sales intelligence and lead generation.
